caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a wooden cabinet, depicted in black ink lines on a beige or off-white background. The cabinet is shown in both front and side elevations. The front elevation includes three drawers, each with two round knobs, and features decorative floral carvings on the upper left drawer and the left vertical side panel. Detailed dimensions are included, such as a total width of 44 inches and a height of 35 1/2 inches. The side elevation shows the depth of the cabinet as 13 1/4 inches, with double doors on the lower half and three knobs on the right side (corresponding to the drawers). Above the cabinet, there is a rectangular area marked as 20 inches in height, possibly indicating a backsplash or additional panel. To the right, small inset drawings illustrate the design of the knob and its cross-sections, as well as a detailed sketch of the floral carving marked “CARVING IN RELIEF.” All text and numeric dimensions are handwritten in ink.
title: Chest of Drawers
